title: antennaria parlinii var. arnoglossa
intro: Antennaria parlinii var. arnoglossa, commonly known as Mountain Snow or Mountain Silver, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for traditional medicine. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Antennaria parlinii var. arnoglossa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
